display.purpose: Page titles, Today's greeting, a note's title.

headline-lg.purpose: Sign-in and boot screens; page titles on phones.

headline.purpose: An agent's card title, an editor's first heading.

headline-sm.purpose: Dialog headings, domain cards, Settings page titles, the one large figure in a widget.

title.purpose: Directory and section titles, the folded masthead, names in team and agent cards.

title-sm.purpose: Today's group titles, card titles, a brief's welcome title.

body-lg.purpose: Small Fraunces card titles, the nav's domain names, long-form inputs.

mark.purpose: Date and stage chips, unread badges; never a sentence.

shadows.purpose: Something small sitting on its surface.

shadows.name: shadow-knob
shadows.purpose: A handle you drag: a slider thumb, a switch.

shadows.name: shadow-well
shadows.purpose: A track or slot pressed in.

shadows.name: shadow-drop
shadows.purpose: A tile or badge standing just off the page.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: The Atlas button and its speech bubble at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet-side
shadows.purpose: The resource peek and the Routines page's routine sheet sliding in from the side.

shadows.name: shadow-sheet-up

shadows.name: ring

shadows.name: shadow-hover
shadows.purpose: A card lifted under the pointer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action in a view; accent fill, springs down on press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: var(--control-height, 34px); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-small, 6px); background: var(--accent, #416b57); color: var(--on-accent, #fffdf8); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--motion-settle, 280ms) var(--ease-settle, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), background var(--motion-quick, 160ms); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #345944); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Every other action; strong-line border that turns accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: var(--control-height, 34px); padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #c8ccbf); border-radius: var(--radius-small, 6px); background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #34382f); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--motion-settle, 280ms) var(--ease-settle, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), border-color var(--motion-quick, 160ms); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #416b57); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Low-stakes actions in rows and headers; a recessed wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-small, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--secondary, #4f5348); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--motion-quick, 160ms), color var(--motion-quick, 160ms); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--recessed, #eeece3); color: var(--accent-ink, #355b48); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Date Chip
components.description: A task's due date; turns clay and says how late when overdue.
components.css: .ds-chip-date { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: var(--radius-xs, 4px); background: var(--accent-soft, #e7ece2); color: var(--accent-ink, #355b48); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs, 11px); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-date.ds-late { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--clay, #ad7761) 18%, var(--panel, #fffdf8)); color: var(--clay-ink, #8f5640); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Narrows a list by kind, with a muted count; selected fills accent-soft.
components.css: .ds-chip-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2d7); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: transparent; color: var(--secondary, #4f5348); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--motion-quick, 160ms), color var(--motion-quick, 160ms); } .ds-chip-filter span { color: var(--muted, #62685c); } .ds-chip-filter:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #c8ccbf); } .ds-chip-filter[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--accent-soft, #e7ece2); border-color: transparent; color: var(--accent-ink, #355b48); } .ds-chip-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Domain Chip
components.description: A domain in the header shelf; the active one fills with its hue.
components.css: .ds-domain-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 14px 4px 4px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--hue) 30%, var(--line, #e2e2d7)); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--hue) 10%, var(--panel, #fffdf8)); color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--hue) 70%, var(--ink, #34382f)); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-sm, 13px); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: transform var(--motion-settle, 280ms) var(--ease-settle, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-domain-chip > span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); font-size: 16px; } .ds-domain-chip[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--hue); border-color: transparent; color: #000; } .ds-domain-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-domain-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Widget Card
components.description: A block on a page: flat panel, hairline border; its kind colour lives only in the heading's icon.
components.html:
The week ahead7 open

Tuesday is the busiest day: 3 tasks.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 360px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2d7); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 16px); background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); box-shadow: var(--panel-shadow, 0 1px 2px #323c290a); color: var(--ink, #34382f); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-card header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); } .ds-card header strong { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card header svg { color: var(--kind); } .ds-card header span { color: var(--muted, #62685c); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: var(--text-md, 14px); line-height: 1.5; color: var(--secondary, #4f5348); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled input; the label sits above in label size.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field span { font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); font-weight: 500; color: var(--secondary, #4f5348); } .ds-field input { padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-field, #898f82); border-radius: var(--radius-small, 6px); background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); color: var(--ink, #34382f); font: inherit; font-size: var(--text-md, 14px); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #62685c); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: An on/off setting; fills with the accent and the knob springs across.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-sm, 13px); color: var(--ink, #34382f); cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch-row input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--line-strong, #c8ccbf); transition: background var(--motion-quick, 160ms); } .ds-switch::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--panel, #fffdf8); box-shadow: var(--shadow-knob, 0 1px 3px #00000040); transition: translate var(--motion-settle, 280ms) var(--ease-settle, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-switch-row input:checked + .ds-switch { background: var(--accent, #416b57); } .ds-switch-row input:checked + .ds-switch::after { translate: 16px 0; } .ds-switch-row input:focus-visible + .ds-switch { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Attention Badge
components.description: Unread and waiting counts; amber with dark numerals.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); background: var(--attention, #f2a531); color: var(--on-attention, #2a2116); font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs, 11px); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-memories { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-memories li { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; max-width: 100%; min-height: 26px; padding: 2px 4px 2px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e2d7); border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); color: var(--muted, #62685c); font-size: var(--text-xs, 12px); } .ds-memories li > svg { flex: none; color: var(--accent-ink, #355b48); } .ds-memories span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-memories li[data-undone] { padding-right: 10px; border-style: dashed; } .ds-memories li[data-undone] > svg { color: var(--muted, #62685c); } .ds-memories button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: none; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: none; color: var(--muted, #62685c); cursor: pointer; opacity: 0; transition: opacity var(--motion-quick, 160ms), background-color var(--motion-quick, 160ms); } .ds-memories li:hover button, .ds-memories button:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-memories button:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, #e7ece2); color: var(--accent-ink, #355b48); } .ds-memories button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #416b57); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (hover: none) { .ds-memories button { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Atlaswork is a place a person returns to every day, so it feels like a well-kept garden shed rather than an office: warm paper surfaces, a deep green accent, earthy clay, ochre and sage, and small living things.
A seed bobs on the active domain, a plant grows with a project's progress, a sticker bounces in, Today's buds flower on the day line in their domain's colour as tasks are ticked, and the sun walks the day line with the hour.
Whimsy is real but rationed: one animated moment per card, never on load, always in answer to something the person did.
Plants (the four growth stages, `src/Plant.tsx`), the sky and motifs (a sprig and hills on the first morning's guide, a footpath with flags) are authored SVG in the palette, not emoji.
Motifs are masks filled with the card's own tint at about a quarter strength, one per card, in a corner.

The app is an Operate surface.
Structure is calm and predictable (a sidebar, a page panel, cards on a twelve-column grid), and personality lives in the details: Fraunces headings, hand-feel radii, a tilt on hover, the domain's own colour carried through its page.

Progressive disclosure is the default: a compact state shows only the icon or face with its words as tooltip (on touch, a long press shows it); text and secondary actions appear on expand, hover or focus.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper in light, mossy charcoal in dark; never pure white or black surfaces. Other themes keep the rule in their own colours.
One accent at a time: the theme's (forest in Garden), the current domain's hue inside a domain.
Fraunces for titles and the one big figure per card (a theme may set its own title face); DM Sans for everything else; one size ladder for both.
Short, settled motion on interaction, a spring only when something grows or lands; nothing moves at rest except a slow seed bob on the active domain.
Dense but legible: labels at 12px, and 11px only inside chips and badges.
Every colour, size, corner and duration comes from a token.

rules.name: The Accent Follows the Domain Rule
rules.body: Inside a domain, its hue becomes the accent: primary buttons, the selected nav item, the active tab and focus rings turn that colour, mixed toward black in light and white in dark. Outside any domain, the accent is forest.

rules.name: The Readable Hue Rule
rules.body: A domain's accent and accent text are capped at oklch lightness 0.52 in the light theme, so paper text on the accent and accent words on paper, recessed and soft fills pass 4.5:1 for every hue. A new hue is checked against that cap before it joins the ten.

rules.name: The Own Colour Rule
rules.body:
A domain's hue appears only where that domain is: its chip, its plant ring, title and progress. A page is never washed in it, and a band never wears it as a stripe along an edge; the masthead uses the theme's second tone (`sidebar`).
A card that stands for one domain or agent may carry that hue as a flat tint of the panel, 8 to 14%: the domain card's heading, the domain dialog's preview, the agent card's band behind the portrait, the agent badge, an agent's speech bubble in Crew (Carlos, 2026-11-16). Never a gradient, and never on a card that only belongs to the place.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: `ink`, `secondary` and `muted` sit at about 12, 8 and 5.6 to 1 on the panel in both themes. Use the lightest tier that still says what the text is; never fade text further with opacity.

rules.name: The Daypart Rule
rules.body: Washes stay behind the panel, never on content.

rules.name: The Ladder Rule
rules.body: Every text size is a step of the ladder. Emoji glyphs size to their tile, and a figure drawn inside a graphic (a ring, a jar, an arc) sizes to the graphic; both may use raw pixels, nothing else does.

rules.name: The Eleven Pixel Floor
rules.body: No text is smaller than 11px, in any density, and 11px is for marks (chips, badges), not for words a person reads in a line. Body copy on phones is at least 12px.

rules.name: The One Figure Rule
rules.body: Each card has at most one large Fraunces figure; everything else in it is label or body size.

rules.name: The Density Rule
rules.body: Comfortable and compact change type, padding, row height and control height together (`--row-height` 45 to 36px, `--control-height` 34 to 30px, `--card-padding` 24 to 18px), never one alone.

rules.name: The Earned Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow grows only on hover, drag or an open overlay.

rules.name: The Named Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow with blur is a `--shadow-*` token. Rings and edges, which have no blur, are drawing and stay with their part.

rules.name: The Ink Not Glow Rule
rules.body: A place shows its colour in ink: a title, an icon, a filled bar, a ring round a face. Never as a coloured shadow, a halo round a dot, a gradient wash across a card, or a stripe down its edge. The exceptions are the flat tint on a place's own card (The Own Colour Rule) and a flat band across a card's top (the agent card behind its portrait, a widget behind its heading).

dos: **Do** reuse the parts in `docs/page-design.md` before adding a new one.
**Do** take every size, corner, duration, shadow, layer and colour from a token, and every gap from the spacing grid; add a token when a value repeats with the same intent three times.

**Do** put a new rule in the sheet that owns its class (`src/styles/`, one sheet per part of the app; the shell, domain chips included, in `src/WorkbenchShell.css`; owners in README, "Where to change the UI"); a sheet that restyles another's class says so in a `restyles` comment.
**Do** carry a domain's hue only in the places The Own Colour Rule names.

**Do** pick a motion duration by its job: `--motion-quick` (160ms) for hover and colour, `--motion-settle` (280ms) for layout and panels, `--motion-pop` (360ms) for a pick answering, `--motion-enter` (440ms) for something arriving, `--motion-flourish` (520ms) for a celebration, `--motion-fill` (700ms) for a bar filling or a line drawing, `--motion-linger` (900ms) for a rare long one-off.

**Do** move with the settle curve (`--ease-settle`) for every hover, press, panel and state change; keep the spring (`--ease-spring`) for keyframed moments when something grows or lands: a plant, a sticker, a tick, a badge. Turn both off under reduced motion.
**Do** show compact states as an icon or face with words in the tooltip, and reveal text on expand, hover or focus.
**Do** check light and dark themes, both densities and a light domain hue (marigold) on the showcase (`/dev/design/`); meet WCAG AA in each.
donts: **Don't** wash a page or masthead in the domain colour or rule its edge in it; the masthead is the `sidebar` tone with a hairline under it.
**Don't** set text under 11px, a sentence at 11px, or a heading between two ladder steps.
**Don't** put the spring on a transition; a hover that bounces reads as a toy.
**Don't** add more than one animated moment per card, or animate on load.
**Don't** use emoji glyphs where a drawn icon exists, except as a domain's own emblem.
**Don't** nest a card inside a widget card.
**Don't** mark a card, row or callout with a coloured stripe down its side; a selected row takes a soft fill, a quotation its indent and voice.
**Don't** seat a heading's icon on a tinted tile, shade a seal like a sphere, or fill a surface with a gradient; tiles are for emblems (a domain's emoji, a plant) and pictures.

**Don't** write a colour literal outside the token file; an illustration in fixed colours (the theme dial) says so with a `token-exempt` comment. A theme's swatch in Settings is drawn from that theme's own tokens, never copied colours.
